Courtesy is the little act that makes a big difference, and respect is the kindness that stays.💛

This month, our Jumpstarters have been learning that good manners go beyond saying please and thank you; they live in the way we speak, listen, share, and treat others 🌱

Today, we brought this beautiful value to life through a series of engaging activities, celebrating the little acts of kindness and respect that make a big difference.

Because at Jumpstart, we’re not just raising learners; we’re nurturing little humans who know how to make the world a kinder place. ✨

Tiny humans, BIG hearts! 💛
Because at Jumpstart, we believe good manners are always in style! 💫
This event will be culmination of these moral values taught to children this month.

WHEN YOU ARE TRUSTED WITH LITTLE LIVES, BEING PREPARED IS NON-NEGOTIABLE🚨
Our educators and staff took part in a fire-safety drill to turn preparedness into practice.
From evacuation protocols to learning how and when to use a fire extinguisher, every step was rehearsed with purpose.
Because in a preschool, safety isn’t just a protocol, it’s a responsibility we practice every day.
Ready before the moment calls for it!

FEAR IS NOT A PLAN. KNOWING WHAT TO DO IS🔥
Today, our little learners didn’t just watch a fire drill but became part of it.
They learnt to stay calm, listen carefully, follow instructions and move safely when the unexpected happens.

Because preparedness gives children something more powerful than fear: the confidence to know what to do.
And sometimes, the best safety lesson is one we practise before we ever need it✅

WHEN THE UNEXPECTED KNOCKS, PREPAREDNESS SHOULD ANSWER 🔔
We don’t just teach children what to learn, we teach them what to do when plans change.
Because safety is a lesson worth practising.

We are not in a hurry to decide what our children will become.
We are busy helping them discover who they want to be.

Kind. Courageous. Respectful. Curious.
Because character is the first career that truly matters✨

How does a tiny seed become the food on our plate? 🌱➡️🍽️
Our young explorers of the 360 program went beyond the classroom to experience the magic of an organic farm and understand the many hands, hours and stages behind every meal.

From soil to harvest, they saw that food doesn’t simply “appear” on our plates!
A little muddy, a lot curious, and with a whole new appreciation for every bite. 🌾💚

🌱 From the farm to their little forks! 🍎
Today’s learning tour was a hands-on lesson in how much love, time and effort goes into the food we eat and why every bite deserves respect. 💚

Before it reaches the plate, every meal has a story. 🌾✨
Our little learners of the 360 program stepped onto an organic farm to discover that story; from planting and nurturing to harvesting and finally, farm to fork.

Because when children see the effort behind their food, they learn to value it, respect it, and waste less.

Today, they didn’t just visit a farm, they discovered the journey behind every bite💚

At Magnet Magic, our little explorers discovered the wonders of attraction, repulsion, and invisible forces; all through hands-on play, experiments, and plenty of “WOW!” moments!
